scope: Current engineering increment; traceability does not close proposal milestones, scientific studies or institutional acceptance.

requirements.acceptance: Load saved decisions and refuse invalid inputs
requirements.evidence_boundary: Saved records only; no live-data ingestion result.

requirements.acceptance: Display all technical/news values, attributions, meanings and coverage
requirements.evidence_boundary: Social features and live freshness remain absent.

requirements.acceptance: Check visible prose independently of structured claims
requirements.evidence_boundary: Supported grammar; no unrestricted semantic verification.

requirements.acceptance: Reject contradictions and missing essential visible claims
requirements.evidence_boundary: Known contradictions are hard failures; default vague-sentence acceptance is disclosed.

requirements.acceptance: Retain failed candidate reporting separately from verified fallback
requirements.evidence_boundary: Fallback success does not relabel the candidate as successful.

requirements.acceptance: Reject unsupported sentences in strict mode
requirements.evidence_boundary: Strict mode checks the maintained grammar.

requirements.acceptance: Block re-runs when data/runtime preflight fails
requirements.evidence_boundary: Structural preflight is not row/schema/cache-coverage or scientific-lock validation.

requirements.acceptance: Bound explicitly configured generator requests and label fallback
requirements.evidence_boundary: Provider fixtures are engineering evidence; no real local/student inference.

requirements.acceptance: Check maintained definitions in prose and JSON
requirements.evidence_boundary: Matching maintained definitions is not independent domain review.

requirements.acceptance: Require frozen evaluation identities and retain null scores without outputs
requirements.evidence_boundary: Plan-only and unavailable-provider receipts are not model quality.

requirements.acceptance: Require all-feature, family and attribution-scope coverage
requirements.evidence_boundary: SHAP explains raw predicted-class score, not calibrated probability or market causation.

requirements.acceptance: Require explicit capacity/tolerance answers and expose reconciliation
requirements.evidence_boundary: Project stand-ins and caps; no validated psychometric or suitability claim.

requirements.acceptance: Fit separate comparator scaling on earlier rows and refuse invalid inputs
requirements.evidence_boundary: Retrospective saved-feature comparator, not the original ingestion-to-linear baseline.

requirements.acceptance: Change only separate profile blend beside the fixed reference
requirements.evidence_boundary: Lower R is not guaranteed conservatism; outcome performance is unmeasured.

requirements.acceptance: Validate declared annotation provenance and freeze social references
requirements.evidence_boundary: Actual AI-reference pilot exists; no second pass, human validation or reliability score.

requirements.acceptance: Require complete paired held-out outputs before sentiment comparison
requirements.evidence_boundary: Candidate inference/selection remains pending; agreement is against AI references.

requirements.acceptance: Load declared local classifier weights and retain raw/error outcomes
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real model loading/inference unexecuted; compatible official weights/runtime missing.

requirements.acceptance: Preserve teacher prose/provenance and separate verified training/validation exports
requirements.evidence_boundary: Six actual all-Buy teacher examples; factual JSON assembled; no student inference/QLoRA or measured user benefit.
